name: builtin-minimal
title: Builtin Minimal (zero-dep greet → draft → finalize, with formal-tone fork)
description: The default zero-dependency demo: a parent run (greet → draft → finalize, friendly tone) plus a child run forked at greet with tone=formal. Synthetic illustrative token/cost numbers on the LLM-kind 'draft' nodes (per ADR-029) so `runs list` shows populated columns out of the box. No real LLM calls.
